title: The Sahara's Hidden Past
hook: The Sahara was once a green land
script: The Sahara was once a green land What did it look like when the first pyramids were being planned? The Sahara's green-to-desert cycle is driven by Earth's axial precession Cave paintings deep in the Sahara still show people swimming The same area is now the dustiest place on Earth
